independent_lead_reviews.name: New Implementation of Prolog (NIP)
independent_lead_reviews.scope_gap: The Bowen link is commented out in the acquired HTML and both manual citations are unlinked. The exact RAL path failed in the web tool and curl could not resolve the HTTPS host. The archive quotations show a reported product and lineage, while an exact independently captured primary identity binding and evidence for the merge or separate implementation boundary are outside this frozen review.

independent_lead_reviews.result: Provisional discovery lead. No frozen claim or source edge for NIP was presented for disposition.
